title: Programmable submission.json + launch plan
goal: Prepare, but do not execute, the Programmable launch-admission artifacts for chain 4663.
steps: Populate submission.json per the builder skill's schema with every provider-bound field knowable today (fee split, hook permission mask, hookData layout per WP-05, the pinned Programmable owner address per WP-05)
Set every unknowable field (deployment addresses, chain-deployment digest) explicitly to null / INTEGRATION_PENDING, never omitted
Write a launch-plan artifact mirroring PhaseOneReleasePlan.sol's pattern, extended to cover the new escrow and chunked-payout contracts
acceptance: Every knowable field is populated; every unknowable field is explicitly null, not omitted
notes: Cannot execute submission until Programmable's Robinhood profile is readiness:available (external, out of the repo's control).
